templates.html:
<dl class="metric metric--{{format}}" style="--accent:{{accent}};">
  <dt class="metric__label">{{label}}</dt>
  <dd class="metric__value" style="font-size:{{size}}px;">{{value}}</dd>
</dl>
<style>
.metric { font: 16px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; color: #241430; background: #FAF7F2; display: inline-grid; gap: 4px; padding: 20px 24px; border-radius: 10px; margin: 0; }
.metric dt, .metric dd { margin: 0; }
.metric__label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .02em; color: var(--accent); text-transform: uppercase; }
.metric__value { font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }
.metric--currency .metric__value::before { content: "$"; }
.metric--percent .metric__value::after { content: "%"; }
</style>
templates.tailwind:
<dl class="metric-tw metric-tw--{{format}} inline-grid gap-1 bg-[#FAF7F2] text-[#241430] font-sans px-6 py-5 rounded-[10px] m-0" style="--accent:{{accent}}">
  <dt class="m-0 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide" style="color:{{accent}}">{{label}}</dt>
  <dd class="m-0 font-bold leading-none" style="font-size:{{size}}px">{{value}}</dd>
</dl>
<style>
.metric-tw--currency dd::before { content: "$"; }
.metric-tw--percent dd::after { content: "%"; }
</style>
